head_scale.note: conv_cls is the head logit the residual is ADDED to; a ratio far below 1 means the residual cannot flip the head argmax at any realistic logit gap, which is a scale statement, not an information statement.

semA_m4floor_ep6.json.note: prior_floor = accuracy of a constant majority-class predictor at fg cells. A z residual that only ever votes the majority class scores exactly this. Only the MARGIN over this floor is evidence of class-specific information in z.

semA_rank_train_ep6.json.reading_note: these booleans describe which failure mode the readings point at; they are not gates and not a pass/fail of candidate A.

semA_rank_val_ep6.json.reading_note: these booleans describe which failure mode the readings point at; they are not gates and not a pass/fail of candidate A.

M4_class_information.donor_rule: first clip (cyclically) whose dominant GT class differs from this clip's; falls back to --shuffle-offset
M4_class_information.note: own_hit = z residual argmax vs the cell GT class; donor_transfer = residual argmax vs the donor clip dominant class after swapping z; head_swap_to_donor = the HEAD class argmax after re-running only the head with the donor residual. Pre-registered bar: chance + 20 pt on the readings that describe z (own_hit / donor_transfer); head_swap is reported with the same bar.

scope: CPU reread only; no new training/evaluation/GPUs; live A2-R evidence capped by epoch.
